title: Token form of every math span of the four spike pages (parity file for core/tex.py)
question: What is D1 §6.2's token form of each math span of the spike pages under its rendition's effective macro table, as a fixture the product's core/tex.py must reproduce?
method: code/i_r2_token_form.py over the S1 renditions (results/s1/canonical, segments): one row per math_inline or math_display span with its canonical-text slice including delimiters, the effective macro table (page macros over the D2 §12.1 fallback), and mathgrammar.token_form's output. Math environments counted as outer delimiters: equation, align, alignat, flalign, gather, multline, eqnarray (and starred forms), displaymath, math (adopted for core/tex.py, operator ruling 2026-10-28). Macro arguments are substituted as a group; no spike-page macro takes arguments.
conclusion: 918 rows of (page, offsets, LaTeX, effective macro table, token form); the product's core/tex.py must reproduce every token_form (copied with provenance to fixtures/tex/token_form_spike_pages.jsonl).
